title: Enrichment of extracellular vesicles using Millipore membrane filters followed by isolation of exosomal RNA from serum or plasma using the Qiagen miRNeasy Micro kit
protocol: Add 500 µL PBS to the AU-0.5 filter, cap, and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 14,000 x g.
Reverse the device and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 1000 x g to remove residual PBS from the filter.
Aspirate PBS from the collection tube.
Transfer 500 µL sample to the AU-0.5 filter and cap the device.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 14,000 x g; approximately 15 µL should remain in the upper chamber.
Remove the device from the centrifuge and empty the collection tube.
Add 0.5 mL PBS to the filter device and gently pipette sample multiple times to mix thoroughly.
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 14,000 x g.
Place the filter upside down in a fresh microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 2000 x g to transfer the sample into the collection tube; discard the filter afterward.
Add 700 µL Qiazol sample to the collection tube and isolate RNA using the miRNeasy micro kit starting from step 3.
